niche_statement: Data-heavy B2B SaaS and services SMBs (workforce/benchmarking analytics, healthcare-finance back office) whose SQL Server/SSIS-era legacy platform — often inherited through acquisition and understood by one or two people — must be stabilized and modernized in place without a rebuild or a full-time CTO.
edp: Bus factor = 1 on a revenue-critical legacy system with calendar-fixed contracted deliverables: one resignation drops delivery to zero while reporting deadlines don't move, and one missed cycle kills the anchor contract that funds the company.
expertise_statements: Take ownership of a legacy .NET / SQL Server application that only one developer currently understands
Modernize our SSIS and SSRS based ETL and reporting pipeline without disrupting client deliverables
Stabilize a fragile production system while continuing to ship features
Document tribal knowledge and establish engineering standards where none exist today
Migrate an on-premise SQL Server workload to Azure or AWS without missing scheduled reporting cycles
Own survey data ingestion and payroll-record ETL that powers client benchmarking reports
Integrate an acquired product's legacy codebase into our platform after the acquisition
Maintain and extend stored-procedure-heavy T-SQL business logic accumulated over many years
Serve as the senior technical leader for a founding team with no technical executive
Reduce delivery risk on releases that are unpredictable and depend on a single engineer
Build data architecture for HRIS and payroll integrations across many client systems
First senior technical hire to professionalize development process as we scale
Level up a small engineering team with code review, mentoring, and clear ownership
Rescue an analytics and reporting platform whose clients depend on contracted scheduled deliverables
Advise founders on modernize-in-place versus rebuild for an aging data platform
Replace ad-hoc manual reporting with reliable automated SSRS / BI reporting
Support a long-lived internal data platform at a financial services or investment research firm
Add pragmatic AI and analytics capabilities on top of an existing legacy data asset
disqualifiers: staffing agency or recruiting firm posting on behalf of clients
deep ML research or PhD-required roles
greenfield-only modern stack with no legacy or data-platform component
enterprise with large existing engineering org (CTO, VPs, and many teams already in place)
pure IT helpdesk or desktop support roles
